signature: type BootError = HostError | ContentHashMismatch | AssetLoadFailed | LoadStalled | RendererUnavailable | BootDefect;
doc: Every way boot can fail; each draws on the runtime's boot failure panel (shared contracts §4).

members.name: HostError
members.doc: Any failure after the handshake. A request that fails never falls back to another path.

members.name: ContentHashMismatch
members.doc: Content hash does not match expected hash.

members.name: AssetLoadFailed
members.doc: An asset download failed with a non-OK HTTP status or network error (status 0).

members.name: LoadStalled
members.doc:
A resource download had no progress reported for STALL_MS (30 s).
Triggers the "Taking a while" screen with a Try again button.

members.name: RendererUnavailable
members.doc:
Neither WebGL2 nor WebGPU could be initialized.
In Ruken this presents the "unsupported" screen with an exit button.
